## 0.0.1

* Background Video Recording: Record videos seamlessly in the background, ensuring uninterrupted functionality even when the app is minimized or terminated (kill state).
* Dual Camera Support: Switch between front and rear cameras for flexible recording options.
* High Compatibility: Designed to work with Android's Camera2 API and MediaRecorder, ensuring stable performance across devices.
* Efficient Resource Management: Optimized for background execution with minimal battery and resource usage.
